notes.title: Update Nov. 24, 2017
notes.content:
[list][*]Bug Fixes
[list][*]In-Game
[list][*]Fixed a problem where the 'Ninja' character was facing to the mouse cursor, ignoring the controller input.[/list]
[*]Miscellaneous
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the game still started from the final stage, when the game was restarted after clearing it.[/list][/list][/list]
